faults.name: keys
faults.summary: write_archive does not archive the machine's Dropbear keys, so the update loses them

edits.find:
if [ -d "$1/etc/dropbear" ]; then
        cp -R "$1/etc/dropbear" "$next_archive/etc/dropbear" ||
            die "the host keys could not be archived"
    fi
    if ssh_host_keys "$1"; then
        { mkdir -p "$next_archive/etc/ssh" && cp "$1"/etc/ssh/ssh_host_* "$next_archive/etc/ssh/"; } ||
            die "OpenSSH's host keys could not be archived"
    fi
    archive_account_keys "$1" || die "the account keys could not be archived"
